prompt.alinti: Download Udemy courses, YouTube playlists, music, and books in one app. No terminal needed. You copy any link, a Udemy course, a YouTube video, a TikTok, a torrent, press control shift D, and it downloads in the background without you ever opening the window.
It also plays everything inside. Video courses, music with synced lyrics, and PDF or EPUB books with highlights and focus mode.
Just download the app for Windows, Mac, or Linux. No admin rights needed. It's a free alternative to paid tools like 4K Video Downloader.
Students use it to save Udemy courses for offline study.
Comment GET and I'll send you the repo link.
